# Market Assessment — MA-001: A Small, Countable, High-ACV Market Wearing the Costume of a Volume Business

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Artifact ID | MA-001 |
| Flow Step | 07 — Research market size (Phase: Market Validation) |
| Owner | PM-001 |
| Upstream inputs | IB-001 v1.0, IOH-001 v1.0, PS-001 v3.0, ICP-001 v3.0, RF-001/H-JM-001 v1.0, POA-001 v3.0 |
| Reviewers this run | CMO-001/PMM-001, CFO-001/FPA-001, CEO-001 (independent, post-production) |
| Version | 3.0 (attempt 3 — supersedes v1.0, v2.0; both returned for self-reported low confidence) |
| **Market sources consulted** | **None. No web search, no browser, no publishing/grant/freelance-market databases, no CRM in this run.** All magnitudes are ESTIMATES with named derivation methods. |
| Overall confidence | **Medium** — on the three structural findings (§0) and the arithmetic in §2–§5, which are derivations over stated priors and do not depend on missing sources. **Low** on every absolute magnitude. |
| Evidence quality | **Low** |
| Gate criteria ("market opportunity passes agreed threshold") | **CONDITIONAL PASS.** No threshold was recorded upstream, so I set one explicitly (§7). It **fails** under the business model as currently written (low price × high volume) and **passes** under the repositioned model this artifact recommends (few buyers × high ACV × multi-pair expansion), conditional on two pre-registered tests. Formal decision: §8. |

---

## 0. What attempt 3 contributes that attempts 1–2 did not

Attempts 1 and 2 tried to produce a large TAM for "English→Bengali book translation." That was the wrong job, and restating it more confidently would be dishonest and useless. I have no market sources this run, so I cannot make the numbers better. What I have done instead is **change which numbers the decision depends on** — using arithmetic over priors the team has already committed to in writing.

Three findings. Each is derived, not sourced. Each contradicts something upstream.

| # | Finding | What it contradicts | Confidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| **F-1** | **There are two different markets here with different sizes, and the one IB-001/IOH-001 priced for is the small one.** The *displacement* market (existing paid spend on English→Bengali book-length translation that we could take from incumbents) is plausibly only **$1M–$22M/yr globally, central ~$4.5M** — too small to support a company, and structurally price-anchored to $200–$1,000 local jobs.
